independently_authored_semantic_families.rule: Distinguish string, numeric, duration and special float forms; malformed syntax must retain source ranges.
Match absent and empty labels according to the exact language profile; selection time is not storage raw-scan boundary semantics.
Apply operand-kind compatibility, vector cardinality, label matching and output-name rules before producing samples; no implicit cross-project aggregation.
Each aggregation requires independent handling of scalar parameters, label grouping, mixed sample kinds, NaNs and ordering.
Preserve exact evaluation timestamps, left-open metric windows, counter resets and histogram precision.
Respect stage order, label collisions, immutable admitted lines, parser failures and structured-metadata separation.
Expose only pinned whitelist functions and explicitly supplied line/time values; forbid external I/O and distinguish runtime failures.
Do not conflate language errors with warnings, removals, annotation order or infrastructure failure.
